findings.passage: Sensible gun legislation is required to make our communities safe for all families.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name as State Treasurer after the January 2023 Southern California mass shootings, reprinted by the Rafu Shimpo (published 2023-01-24). She calls for gun legislation to protect communities. Her office's press release is dated 2023-01-22 but its own page is unreachable.

findings.passage: When will our lawmakers listen to the majority of Americans who agree that enough is enough and we need sensible gun safety laws?
findings.note: Same statement, as reprinted by the Rafu Shimpo. She asks lawmakers to enact gun safety laws and says the prevalence of guns threatens lives.

findings.passage: I will not stop advocating for change until we make sure more life-saving legislation is signed into law.
findings.note: Same statement, as reprinted by the Rafu Shimpo. She commits to keep pushing for more life-saving legislation after the shootings.
